name: NSFDC Micro-Credit & Term Loan Scheme for SCs
description: Concessional credit and term loan support by NSFDC (Ministry of Social Justice and Empowerment) providing loans up to ₹15 Lakh at 6% interest rate for Scheduled Caste entrepreneurs establishing rural micro-enterprises.
nodalAgency: National Scheduled Castes Finance and Development Corporation (NSFDC), Ministry of Social Justice and Empowerment
targetAudience: Scheduled Caste (SC) micro-entrepreneurs, rural artisans, and self-employed youth
